image_description: A low-angle shot of a massive radio telescope featuring a large, open-mesh parabolic dish antenna. The dish is supported by a complex steel lattice framework and mounted on a substantial brick cylindrical base with windows. A central feed horn assembly protrudes from the center of the dish. The background shows a cloudy sky and some trees.
